'''Bashrar''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who worked as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Voontara Fa'athra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. They had a sizeable [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on their head and, in [[3643 BBY]], was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] on the grounds of [[Fa'athra's Palace]].

==Biography==
Bashrar was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]]<ref name="Bonus" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] in the employ of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Voontara Fa'athra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. They were a criminal and had a significant [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on their head.<ref name="Bonus" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> Bashrar spent [[Time/Legends|time]] in the grounds of [[Fa'athra's Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where the Sullustan and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] also serving in the Hutt's [[Fa'athra gang|forces]] stood by a pair of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]].<ref name="Bonus" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
A [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] aiming to participate in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] infiltrated Fa'athra's Palace while trying to gain the sponsorship of Fa'athra's rival, [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]. Knowing they needed more [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to fund their efforts in the Great Hunt, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hunter's]] companion, [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]], identified several of Fa'athra's men who had bounties on them for the bounty hunter,<ref name="Sponsorship">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|My Sponsorship|Nal Hutta}}</ref> who then located Bashrar by the [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] bikes and [[Death/Legends|killed]] them.<ref name="Bonus" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Bashrar had light skin and [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They spoke [[Sullustese/Legends|Sullustese]].<ref name="Bonus" />

==Equipment==
Bashrar donned a black [[shirt]] and pants with a gray and purple tunic. They also wore brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]], black [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], a brown [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]] and [[Belt/Legends|belt]], and a pair of brown [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]]. In combat, they used two [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and [[thermal grenade]]s.<ref name="Bonus" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bashrar appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as a target of the optional bonus mission "Additional Bounties Available," which is only available to players of the Bounty Hunter class.<ref name="Bonus" />
